brief.text: Redesign the existing Loja na Esquina home dashboard for a small neighborhood shop, following src/DESIGN.md and preserving its metrics, low-stock list and quick actions.
assumptions: Dark mode is the default and only focus for this screen.
Keep all current metrics, low-stock items, Portuguese copy and existing routes.
Use the existing React Native file and conventions; no new dependencies.

findings.fix: Remove the avatar and keep the header focused on the existing NHAFIN brand.
findings.problem: The invented profile avatar suggests an account feature that does not exist in the app.
